verdictStatement: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. The central equality test passes in every copy: the three-class list is == equal in the join's OBL-G16-FX-AUTHORING, live G16 v2's namedCorpusNotAuthored, live catalog v1's namedCorpusNotAuthored, live G16 v2's namedExecutesLimbs, and live G16 v2's namedCorpusClasses memberVerbatim — and also in a sixth copy embedded as JSON inside OBL-G16-NAMED-CATALOG's reason prose, which I parsed out and compared because a list quoted inside a string is where a drifted copy hides. OBL-G16-NAMED-CATALOG carries leftoverDesign false in specifiedNotLeftover, scoped to the naming claim and expressly declining to close the fixture obligation, while OBL-G16-FX-AUTHORING and OBL-CI-ENCODING-RESERVED both remain leftoverDesign true as the only members of the leftover set. No CI encoding is invented: the sweep finds no provider, no YAML, no path filter, no cache, no command and no tooling anywhere, and reservedForBlueprintVerbatim is == equal to live v16's reservedForBlueprint at six members in order. All twenty-three cited path/digest pairs measure equal with zero mismatches, recordedInputs.HEAD equals the top-level head and live HEAD, v16 is not applied and measures CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, nothing is SATISFIED, no DR-G* row is added, required-now is 26, and the subject did not move. Four further refutations of my own — an invented identifier, a drifted prose copy of the list, overstated cited standings, and a smuggled D9 or recipe — all failed. The identifier probe is worth naming: IR-1 and IR-4 appear beside a disclaimer that no IR-* identifier is invented, which reads as a self-contradiction until located, but the occurrence is a quotation of v16's own sentence and both tokens are live in v16 and in G16 v2.
